Fixes invalid geometries, removes the empty ones and cleans polygons of small holes and narrow slivers.

**Toolbox folder:** Vector Processing<br>
**Status:** Certified<br>
**Keywords:** JTS, Clean, Invalid, Holes, Slivers, Vector<br>
**Authors:** Andrea Antonello<br>
**Class:** `org.hortonmachine.modules.VectorCleaner`

**Inputs**

| Parameter | Type | Unit | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `inMap` | vector file |  |  | The vector to clean: points, lines or polygons. |
| `pMaxHoleArea` | double |  | `300.0` | The max area of the holes to fill. 0 fills none. |
| `pMinWidth` | double |  | `10.0` | The min width of holes and of spikes and notches of the outline: narrower ones are cleaned. 0 cleans none. |
| `pMinSliverLength` | double |  | `30.0` | The min length of a narrow spike or notch of the outline to be cleaned, to keep the sharp corners. |
| `doFillNotches` | boolean |  | `true` | Fill the narrow notches of the outline. |
| `doFillGaps` | boolean |  | `true` | Fill the narrow gaps between the parts of a feature, joining them. |
| `pPrecision` | String |  | `mm` | The precision of the overlays: mm, cm, dm or m. Allowed values: `mm`, `cm`, `dm`, `m`. |
| `pOverlaps` | String |  | `none` | What to do with the overlaps between polygons: none (not looked for), mark (only added to the changes), largest (kept by the larger feature) or first (kept by the feature that comes first). Allowed values: `none`, `mark`, `largest`, `first`. |

**Outputs**

| Parameter | Type | Unit | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `outMap` | output file |  | The cleaned features, with their attributes. |
| `outChanges` | output file |  | The outlines of what was fixed or cleaned, as lines. |
